scope: One scratch recipe trial on the original fixed Navigation8 training scenes; not an isolated causal test or formal three-seed acceptance.
evidence: Historical scratch_v02/depth_ppo_s0 at1120 had25/25 S01,25 S02,0 S03,24 D01,20 D02,23 D03; source config usedh32/lambda.95/Zhang shaping. Current procedural goal-reaching pilots and all bounded continuations still failed retention.
hypothesis: Task-matched fixed-scene training may achieve the target more reliably than the procedural distribution. Long-return targets retain their previously measured lower bootstrap bias; no claim that earlier failed continuation variants were convergence fixes.
initialization: Independent random actor/critic, seed0, no previous model or teacher weights.
comparison_limits: This recipe differs from historical fixed-scene PPO in reward, observations and return horizon. It cannot identify a unique cause. It changes only configuration and uses the existing fixed-scene training path; no new environment abstraction.
quality_gate: Fixed development seeds, six primary scenes8episodes each. First screening pass triggers original25episode full validation with23/25 required per scene. Actual final checkpoint and every screen are retained, with earliest nonzero-success retention measured.
stopping: Complete256 updates unless the existing first-full-validation selection passes or a genuine runtime failure occurs. Patience cannot stop before budget. A selected candidate still requires the900000-interaction stability window, new scratch seeds and independent final testing.
evaluation_scope: Training uses fixed scene geometry as in historical BPTT/SHAC. Training initialization seeds are independent of validation/test seeds. This is task convergence, not an unseen-geometry generalization claim.
not_retained: No extra critic fits, no memory-conditioned critic, no rehearsal penalty.
